consequence.statement: Existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update of status.storedVersions must be run before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all UpdateRequest objects and update status.storedVersions on the CRD before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD changes from v1beta1 to v2 (1.12.6 → 1.13.0); existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so a storage version migration is needed before v1beta1 is removed.
